3899-6277-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5231-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5231-5789.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

348-1152-2992-6255-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-6255-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Zahur triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-4772-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Doubling Season
Repeat.

3240-5632-6462-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Chalk Outline triggers, creating a Treasure token, Clue token and creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1818-2034-3490-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2034-3490-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1171-1409-4359.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

628-2292-7194.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

2919-3490-5231-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-5231-6097.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1492-4927.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-4927.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3234-3293-3967-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-3967-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-3967-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

339-677-1115-2438.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3305-3817-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1737-4050-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

222-308-2438-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-308-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing a nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on Carrion Feeder.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
222-308-2438-4871.notes: You may sacrifice Carrion Feeder alongside Slimefoot and Squee, tapping it each time using Embalmer's Tools to get infinite mill and/or self-mill.

1410-2141-4447-4962.description:
At the beginning of combat, Captain Rex Nebula triggers, making Brazen Dwarf a Vehicle and giving it Crew 2 and "Whenever this Vehicle deals damage, roll a six-sided die and sacrifice this Vehicle if the result is equal to its mana value" until end of turn.
Activate Brazen Dwarf's Crew ability by tapping Captain Rex Nebula, making it a creature until end of turn.
Activate Assault Suit's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to Brazen Dwarf.
Declare Brazen Dwarf as an attacker and deal combat damage with it.
Brazen Dwarf's ability from Captain Rex Nebula triggers, causing you to roll a six-sided die and fail to sacrifice Brazen Dawrf regardless of the result due to Assault Suit's ability.
Brazen Dwarf triggers from the die roll, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

1636-4152-4694.notablePrerequisites:
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
1636-4152-4694.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 artifact creature, and therefore dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

467-1636-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Shorikai does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to cause Shorikai to become a creature this turn.
467-1636-2034.description:
Cause Shorikai to become a creature.
Activate Shorikai by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to draw two cards, discard a card, and create a 1/1 Pilot creature token.
The Pilot enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pilot, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1628-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
1628-4050-4186.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Squirrel token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

248-2506.easyPrerequisites: any creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
248-2506.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, its champion ability and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Changeling Berserker with haste.
When the Changeling Berserker token enters the battlefiled, its champion ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Changeling Berserker until the token Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the champion ability from step 2, exiling the token Changeling Berserker.
The token Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, returning the nontoken Changeling Berserker from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
